lines.en: label wakanasummer2morninggen:
scene wakanasummer2morninggen
I call up Wakana to find that she’s spending the morning in her office to grade papers and keep her plants company.
lines.zh: 我给 Wakana 打电话，发现她整个上午都要待在办公室里改卷子、陪她的盆栽。

lines.en: Why plants need company, I don’t know. But I decide to join her anyway seeing as I have nothing else to do and feel the need to be reminded of how miserable and pointless life is every few minutes.
lines.zh: 植物为什么需要陪伴，我不知道。但我还是决定过去——反正我也没别的事干，而且每隔几分钟就需要被提醒一次人生有多悲惨、多没意义。

lines.en: Wakana does not disappoint in that regard, bashing me over the head with her catchphrase immediately upon my arrival before asking me to do all of her work for her so she can take a nap.
lines.zh: Wakana 在这方面没让我失望——我刚到她就用她的口头禅给我当头一棒，然后要我把她所有的活都干完，好让她睡个午觉。

lines.en: I’m surprised that she’s even {i}okay{/i} with the prospect of taking a nap in the same room as me, but...I guess there’s a lot about our dynamic that I’m being constantly surprised about.
lines.zh: 我挺意外她居然能{i}接受{/i}跟我待在同一个房间里午睡，不过……我想我们之间的相处状态，本来就有太多事让我不断感到意外。

lines.en: Anyway, surprise or not, I refuse Wakana’s task as I can’t even be bothered with grading my {i}own{/i} papers, let alone hers.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，意外归意外，我拒绝了 Wakana 的任务——我连{i}自己{/i}的卷子都懒得改，更别说她的。

lines.en: She goes back to watering her plants with a sigh and mentions that she’ll just grade everything from home later on tonight.
lines.zh: 她叹了口气继续给植物浇水，说晚上回家再改就好。

lines.en: This, of course, calls into question why she even bothered coming here in the first place if she was just going to shrug it off since...I don’t think plants need to be watered every day.
lines.zh: 这当然就引出了一个问题：既然她反正要推掉，那她一开始干嘛还来这儿……而且我觉得植物不用每天都浇水。

lines.en: I’m no botanist, though. So I may very well be completely off the mark with that.
lines.zh: 不过我又不是植物学家。所以这点上我可能完全错了。

lines.en: scene black

Wakana finishes up providing [[potentially] needed water for her foliage friends and collapses onto the couch seconds later before, you guessed it, once again complaining about how painful it is to be alive.
lines.zh: Wakana 给她的叶子朋友们浇完「[可能]需要的」水，几秒钟后就瘫在沙发上，然后——你猜对了——又开始抱怨活着有多痛苦。

lines.en: I join her in an attempt to complain as well only to be berated and told that I don’t understand, which is fair since my life is pretty great.
lines.zh: 我也试着加入一起抱怨，结果被训了一顿，说我不懂——这倒也公道，毕竟我的人生挺不错的。

lines.en: But, without knowing too much about Wakana, hers seems like it’s not that bad either.
lines.zh: 不过，虽然我对 Wakana 了解不多，她的人生看起来也没那么糟。

lines.en: I guess you can never really know for sure, though.
lines.zh: 我想这种事永远也说不准。

lines.en: Minutes later, I am told to get lost so Wakana can go {i}tend to something-{/i} whatever that means.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，我被告知可以滚了，Wakana 要去{i}处理点事{/i}——管它是什么意思。

lines.en: I oblige and, before I know it, I’m back outside of the school and looking for something to do.
lines.zh: 我照办，回过神来时，我已经站在学校外面找事做。

lines.en: $ wakana_love += 1
{i}Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!{/i}
jump saturdayafternoon
